capabilities: Scroll card feeds of random vault notes
Filter feeds with Obsidian search queries and folder, tag, or filename exclusions
Preview notes, PDFs, videos, and standalone attachments
Configure per-feed preview length, formatting, and shown properties
Create and switch between multiple named feeds
disambiguation: Not a social media feed; it only shows random notes from your own vault in a scrolling card layout.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README asks 'You write and save a lot. How often do you look at it again?', implying the author wanted a way to rediscover saved notes.
problem: Users accumulate many notes but rarely revisit them, and Obsidian offers no feed-like way to resurface forgotten ones.

relations.evidence: Major plugins like Bases or Dataview supported
Previews also support Dataview and Bases content

summary: Feed-style browser that surfaces random notes from your vault as scrollable cards with per-feed search filters and preview settings.
